title: Privacy Policy
intro: Global Virtual Experts ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information we collect, how we use and protect that information, and the choices you have concerning your personal data.
By accessing or using our website, www.globalvirtualexperts.com (the "Website"), you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
Our Terms of Use are included near the end of this page.

blocks.text: We may collect various types of personal information from users, including but not limited to names, email addresses, phone numbers, mailing addresses, IP addresses, and other data you provide to us through forms or interactions with our Website.

We collect information when you voluntarily submit it through forms on our Website, when you sign up for our services, when you communicate with us, or when you use our Website's features that require the input of personal information.
We use the collected information for purposes including but not limited to:
Providing and improving our services
Communicating with you about your account or inquiries
Sending you updates, newsletters, and promotional materials
Analyzing and enhancing user experience on our Website
Responding to legal obligations or requests from authorities

We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encryption, access controls, regular security assessments, and more.

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except for trusted third parties who assist us in operating our Website and conducting our business, as long as they agree to keep this information confidential. No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.
We may use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about your interactions with our Website. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You can also object to or restrict the processing of your data. If you wish to exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by the "Last Updated" date at the top of the policy. We recommend reviewing this page periodically to stay informed about our privacy practices.

These Terms of Use apply when you visit this Website or contact Global Virtual Experts through it. By using the Website or submitting a form, you agree to these Terms of Use and to the Privacy Policy above. Last updated: October 8, 2026.

Our services. This Website describes our virtual assistant services in general terms. The details, pricing, and terms of any service we provide to you are set out in your written agreement with Global Virtual Experts.

Communications. When you submit a form or agree to receive communications, you allow Global Virtual Experts to contact you by email, phone call, and text message about your inquiry, scheduled calls, and our services. Calls may be recorded, and messages may be sent using automated technology. Agreeing to be contacted is not a condition of purchasing any product or service.

Text messages. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, or reply STOP at any time to stop receiving text messages. Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. We do not share your mobile number or text messaging consent with third parties for marketing purposes, as described in Third-Party Sharing above.
Using this Website. Please give accurate information in our forms and use the Website only for lawful purposes. Do not try to disrupt the Website or access it in ways it is not intended to be used.
Content. The text, logos, images, and videos on this Website belong to Global Virtual Experts or are used with permission. Please do not copy or reuse them without our written permission.
Third-party services. This Website uses services from other companies, such as video, scheduling, and payment providers. When you use those services, their own terms and privacy policies also apply.
Availability. We work to keep the Website accurate and available, but we cannot guarantee that it will always be complete, error-free, or uninterrupted.
Changes. We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Changes take effect when they are posted on this page.
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests related to your personal information or this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
